verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for a team chat platform, but the evidence never documents a recurring scheduler in Zulip. The interactive bot framework only reacts to incoming messages, and the Zapier/IFTTT integrations are third-party tools, not Zulip's own capability. A user-built bot running on the Botserver is a developer building block, not a native recurring-schedule feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
